description: This file defines types, constants, and functions related to Feishu card interactions, including encoding, decoding, and validation of interaction envelopes and actions.

methods.name: isRecord
methods.description: Type guard to check if a value is a non-null object.

methods.name: isInteractionKind
methods.description: Type guard to verify if a value is a valid FeishuCardInteractionKind.

methods.name: isMetadataValue
methods.description: Type guard to verify if a value is a valid metadata value (string, number, boolean, null, or undefined).

methods.name: createFeishuCardInteractionEnvelope
methods.description: Creates a FeishuCardInteractionEnvelope with the specified properties, adding the version constant.

methods.name: buildFeishuCardActionTextFallback
methods.description: Generates a fallback text representation of a FeishuCardActionEventLike.

methods.name: decodeFeishuCardAction
methods.description: Decodes a FeishuCardActionEventLike into a structured, legacy, or invalid action, performing validation and checks.
